title: Quick-Fix Glassy-Jelly German Soya Bean Pilaf
description: A German-inspired, low-calorie-friendly dish featuring soya bean, score-fat, and a glassy-jelly texture that can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add score-fat and stir to coat the pan.
Add soya beans and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add soy sauce, maple syrup, and water to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the glassy-jelly mixture over cooked rice or noodles and garnish with chopped fresh herbs.
Garnish with chopped parsley or chives for added flavor and texture.
Serve hot and garnish with sliced almonds or sesame seeds for added crunch.
Garnish with sliced almonds or sesame seeds for added crunch and flavor.
Serve with your favorite side dish, such as steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
Serve with steamed broccoli or a simple green salad for a well-rounded meal.
